constraints: If menu is passed as a MenuRef, the process parameter is ignored.

overloadMerges.note: Added sentinelValues on menuItem for the two documented special values (-1 = last item added; 0 = all items of the menu at once, per the docs' Tip).

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the menu
all items of the menu at once

params.name: process
params.description: Process reference number; if omitted, applies to the menu bar of the current process

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Enables (makes selectable) the specified menu item, or all items of a submenu/menu, in a given process's menu bar.
